items.title: Disgraced footballer Nicky Winmar removed from AFL Hall of Fame
items.description: Winmar was found guilty earlier this month of three counts of unlawful assault and common law assault.

items.title: Woman with alleged links to Islamic State needs medical help, court told
items.description: A woman who was arrested over alleged links to the Islamic State terror group upon her arrival in Sydney has been denied bail for a second time, despite her lawyer saying she needed treatment for "significant psychological damage".

items.title: University of Melbourne defends management of antisemitism on campus
items.description: A royal commission has heard the University of Melbourne has been improving its processes for students to make complaints in the wake of antisemitic experiences by staff and students which escalated in 2024.

items.title: Sydney childcare abuse investigation expands to South Australia
items.description: A federal police investigation into an alleged childcare abuser has expanded to a remote Indigenous community in South Australia.

items.title: Timor-Leste scam centre compounds uncovered as police make 300 arrests
items.description: Police in Timor-Leste uncover a major international scam centre in the country, arresting more than 300 Chinese, Indonesian and Cambodian nationals in raids across the capital, Dili.

items.title: Moira Deeming makes last-ditch plea to Liberal Party to retain candidacy
items.description: Victorian MP Moira Deeming faces being disendorsed as a Liberal candidate for refusing to apologise to former party leader Matthew Guy, after accusing him of assaulting her at a community event in May.

items.title: Man shot dead in Sydney's north-west in 'very brazen attack'
items.description: A man has been shot dead in Sydney's north-west, with the homicide squad now leading the investigation.

items.title: Live: Government to force data centres to minimise water usage, underwrite own power under new AI standards
items.description: The PM is is outlining a national framework to deal with the emergence of artificial intelligence. Follow live.

items.title: Live: US, Iran exchange fire as Trump issues new threats and blockade begins
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he will not charge a 20 per cent toll on traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, just hours before the US Navy's blockade is set to resume.

items.title: Australia's best-paid CEO makes 500 times the average salary
items.description: Australia's most highly paid executive collected a salary nearly 500 times that of the country's full-time average worker.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
